Chapter 3 - Code Fragment Manager

Code Fragment Manager Reference

This section describes the data structures and routines provided by the Code Fragment Manager. See "Using the Code Fragment Manager" beginning on page 3-10 for detailed instructions on using these routines. This section also describes the format of the optional initialization and termination routines you can include in a fragment, as well
as the structure of the code fragment resource.
